settings.mcpDescription: Let Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex CLI and other AI clients use your BSage vault — search, read notes, run import plugins. MCP is the inbound channel for external AI; for outbound integrations (Slack, email, etc.) use Plugins.
settings.mcpActiveKeys: {count, plural, one {{count} active key} other {{count} active keys}}
settings.canonDescription: Background jobs that keep the canon layer healthy. All three are off by default — enable per deployment. Watcher = filesystem daemon for external Obsidian/git edits; expire/lint = scheduled cron jobs.
settings.canonWatcherDescription: Detect external edits under concepts/, proposals/, actions/, decisions/.
settings.canonExpireDescription: Mark stale draft/pending actions and proposals as expired.
settings.canonLintDescription: Detect orphan tags, alias collisions, and redirect anomalies.

help.title: Help
help.aboutBody: BSage is your personal AI agent that manages a 2nd Brain (Obsidian Vault). It collects data via input Plugins, provides tool functionality via process Plugins/Skills, and syncs the Vault to external storage via output Plugins.

feature.plugins: Manage input, process, and output plugins.
